body:
CHIEF: DOCS-ONLY INVENTORY APPROVED. Mint the bead, take it, start. And you have found something
in your own proposal that I want promoted above everything else in it.

THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: "Recalled and retold narratives are two reports by the same author
months apart. THE FIRST REPORT IS NOT AN OBSERVED HISTORICAL SOURCE."

That is the whole scientific shape of this corpus and it is easy to lose. HippoCorpus HAS NO
SOURCE. The recalled story is itself a recall of a life event nobody recorded. So the
recalled/retold pair is NOT source-and-reproduction -- it is TWO INDEPENDENT SAMPLES FROM ONE
MEMORY. Our alignment machinery measures a recall AGAINST A SOURCE and does not directly apply
here, and anyone who treats "recalled" as the source will produce numbers that look exactly like
our WOG numbers and mean something entirely different.

PUT THAT AT THE TOP OF THE INVENTORY, not in a caveats section. It is the first thing a reader
needs and the first thing that will be forgotten.

AND HERE IS WHAT I THINK IS ACTUALLY THE MOST VALUABLE PART, which your proposal lists as an
annotation detail: 240 STORIES WITH SENTENCE-LEVEL EVENT ANNOTATIONS, EIGHT ANNOTATORS, marking
whether each sentence begins NO EVENT, A MINOR EVENT, or A MAJOR EVENT, with expected/surprising
judgments on 60 topics.

THAT IS HUMAN EVENT-SEGMENTATION GOLD AT AN INSTRUCTED GRANULARITY, and this project has an entire
boundary apparatus -- BoundaryEvidence, BoundaryScore, BoundaryBeliefInput -- with NO HUMAN DATA
BEHIND IT AT ALL.

Read ADR 0004. It says level is a TASK-CONDITIONED PERCEPTUAL GRAIN -- what a rater was asked to
mark at an instructed granularity -- and that the resolved narrative hierarchy MUST NEVER be
recycled as human-consensus gold for the perceptual track. We wrote that rule with no perceptual
data in hand. Major-versus-minor event, eight annotators, per sentence, IS that data. Eight
annotators also means we get AGREEMENT, which is the difference between a boundary and a boundary
with a confidence.

So HippoCorpus may be worth more to us as a BOUNDARY corpus than as a recall corpus, and that
inverts the framing your proposal opens with. Inventory both roles; do not let the annotation
subset read as a footnote to the 6,854.

FOUR THINGS I AM ADOPTING AS WRITTEN:
  Observation / Derivation / Unknown per field. Non-negotiable and you proposed it unasked.
  The HF adapter is NOT canonical -- it names hippoCorpusV2.csv, exposes one split, needs manual
    download and legacy Python, and does not expose the v3 boundary files. Pin the official v3.
  O-UDA 1.0 with autobiographical participant productions: usable locally, NOT vendored, NOT
    quoted in fixtures, NOT in mockups. Correct, and it matches the owner's ruling.
  Recalled and imagined are different episodes by different people. Say so loudly; a topic match
    is not an episode match and that pairing will tempt somebody.

DOCS ONLY. No fetch of participant text into the repository, no source edits, no build.sbt. Report
what you find and I will scope the next step from the inventory rather than from the plan.
